Task 2: Prepare a Techno-Economic Assessment (“TEA”) Report evaluating the costs and risks of commercialization of the proposed technology. As appropriate, the Techno-Economic Assessment Report will discuss the following: • Critical production processes, equipment, facilities, personnel resources, and support systems needed to commercialize the technology on the production scale; • Identify fabrication and construction costs, catalyst and other critical supplier technologies, capacity constraints imposed by the design under consideration design- critical elements, and the use or production of hazardous or non-recyclable materials; • The estimated cost of production; • The expected investment threshold needed to launch the first commercial facility; and • An implementation plan to ramp up to commercialization. Task 3: Support SoCalGas in the drafting of the RG Test Plan and the final Proof of Compliance with Utility RG Specifications.
